日本帝國統計年鑑 1930

Nippon Teikoku tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the Empire of Japan), 第四十九回 (No. 49), 昭和五年 (Shōwa 5)
內閣統計局 (東京統計協會 發賣), 東京, 1930

All 437 numbered tables are transcribed, with the summary tables (摘要表) at the front (439 tables, about 252,000 figure cells); the contents, the index, the weights-and-measures table, the two pages of charts (which print no figures), the prose survey (略說), the list of sources, the bureau's list of publications and the colophon are not. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 through the API (llm CLI) from full-resolution tiles of the page; nothing was checked by eye. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections are joined. Printed totals were re-added by the reader: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted; where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. The book misnumbers two tables on pp. 396–397 (printed 368 and 369 again; the contents list them as 371 and 372): the printed numbers are kept. The volume's errata slip (正誤表, 31 corrections) is attached as a note to each table it concerns; the figures stay as printed. 285 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?.
